messages.author: 21023c4b9e2f975d
messages.subject: Annotating multiple clades at once
parts:
#Hi I am trying to annotate the clades of a phylogenetic tree and I was wondering if it is possible to annotate multiple clades with different labels each, using a single line of code.


tree<-
structure(list(edge = structure(c(23L, 24L, 25L, 26L, 27L, 28L, 
28L, 27L, 26L, 25L, 29L, 30L, 30L, 29L, 24L, 31L, 32L, 33L, 33L, 
34L, 35L, 36L, 36L, 35L, 34L, 37L, 37L, 32L, 31L, 23L, 38L, 38L, 
39L, 40L, 40L, 41L, 42L, 42L, 41L, 39L, 23L, 24L, 25L, 26L, 27L, 
28L, 1L, 2L, 3L, 4L, 29L, 30L, 5L, 6L, 7L, 31L, 32L, 33L, 8L, 
34L, 35L, 36L, 9L, 10L, 11L, 37L, 12L, 13L, 14L, 15L, 38L, 16L, 
39L, 40L, 17L, 41L, 42L, 18L, 19L, 20L, 21L, 22L), .Dim = c(41L, 
2L)), edge.length = c(0.0988133, 0.0502699, 0.0390186, 0.0673225, 
0.0707048, 0.3200694947, 0.2388876258, 0.3311086258, 0.374507, 
0.0749855, 0.138623, 0.3212036258, 0.255007, 0.416594, 0.0839065, 
0.0901448, 0.0945897, 0.9395292516, 0.122442, 0.142712, 0.374957, 
0.378005, 0.338451, 0.406115, 0.231957, 0.2397346, 0.401182, 
0.6638032516, 0.4770456258, 0.11299, 0.155735, 0.10066, 0.206513, 
0.00495645, 0.00861214, 0.00334488, 0.2193385, 3.25156e-06, 3.25156e-06, 
0.199741, 0.63819182), Nnode = 20L, node.label = c("86", "34", 
"80", "73", "68", "100", "89", "75", "87", "84", "83", "85", 
"89", "99", "98", "86", "91", "100", "74", "82"), tip.label = c("Megacopta_cribraria", 
"Nezara_viridula", "Pyrrhocoris_apterus", "Oncopeltus_fasciatus", 
"Abedus_herberti", "Lethocerus_deyrollei", "Phymata_pennsylvanica", 
"Hyalesthes_obsoletus", "Centrodontus_atlas", "Microcentrus_caryae", 
"Kronides_incumbens", "Umbonia_crassicornis", "Umbonia_ataliba", 
"Cimex_lectularius", "Corythucha_ciliata", "Platymeris_biguttata", 
"Triatoma_infestans", "Triatoma_maculata", "Triatoma_infestans", 
"Triatoma_infestans", "Rhodnius_prolixus", "Callosobruchus_maculatus"
)), class = "phylo", order = "cladewise")


taxo<-
structure(list(species = structure(c(9L, 11L, 15L, 12L, 1L, 8L, 
13L, 6L, 3L, 10L, 7L, 20L, 19L, 4L, 5L, 14L, 17L, 18L, 17L, 17L, 
16L, 2L), .Label = c("Abedus_herberti", "Callosobruchus_maculatus", 
"Centrodontus_atlas", "Cimex_lectularius", "Corythucha_ciliata", 
"Hyalesthes_obsoletus", "Kronides_incumbens", "Lethocerus_deyrollei", 
"Megacopta_cribraria", "Microcentrus_caryae", "Nezara_viridula", 
"Oncopeltus_fasciatus", "Phymata_pennsylvanica", "Platymeris_biguttata", 
"Pyrrhocoris_apterus", "Rhodnius_prolixus", "Triatoma_infestans", 
"Triatoma_maculata", "Umbonia_ataliba", "Umbonia_crassicornis"
), class = "factor"), infraorder = structure(c(8L, 8L, 8L, 8L, 
7L, 7L, 3L, 4L, 2L, 2L, 2L, 2L, 2L, 3L, 3L, 3L, 3L, 3L, 3L, 3L, 
3L, NA), .Label = c("", "Cicadomorpha", "Cimicomorpha", "Fulgoromorpha", 
"Gerromorpha", "Leptopodomorpha", "Nepomorpha", "Pentatomomorpha"
), class = "factor"), suborder = structure(c(3L, 3L, 3L, 3L, 
3L, 3L, 3L, 2L, 2L, 2L, 2L, 2L, 2L, 3L, 3L, 3L, 3L, 3L, 3L, 3L, 
3L, NA), .Label = c("", "Auchenorrhyncha", "Heteroptera"), class = "factor")), class = "data.frame", row.names = c(NA, 
-22L))


#The first column of taxo matches the tip labels

t=ggtree(tree,branch.length = "none")

t +
  geom_tiplab(align=TRUE, linesize=0)+
  theme_tree2()+
  xlim(0,11)+
  geom_text2(aes(subset=!isTip,label=label), hjust=-.2,size=2.5)+
  geom_cladelabel(node=1, label=taxo$infraorder[1], align=T, hjust=-1, geom='label')


#the last line of the code adds the suborder of the species next to the species name. I could repeat that last line 21 times in order to do the same for all the species, because this is just a test tree, while I want to do that in a tree with hundreds of tips.
# Many thanks in advance!
